scope: Visual pagination QA of the exact HTML report captured from the application browser preview, using an independent PDF renderer.

browserHTMLPreview.verifiedBy: Parent agent in managed CUA browser

report.selectedRunProvenance: Fresh completed run; no restored-backup notice expected for selected run.

pageReview.contents: Report identity, completed revision 7 status, immutable schematic, component values. Mirrored horizontal capacitor ground wire approaches the right pin from below; no body crossing. All symbols, wire labels and probe numbers are visible.

Numerical evidence begins with its plot. Export legend identifies Output and Input by color and solid/dashed comparison semantics. Both magnitude and phase curves and axes fit. Baseline caption, measurements, assumptions and corrected 72.34 Hz interpretation fit without clipping.

Active AC configuration and solver fields, engine/model provenance, limitations, exact netlist and complete short engine log fit. The footer remains on this page, with no orphan page or split short log.

limitations: This verifies the browser-generated report content and independent-renderer pagination, not the native Chrome Print or Save as PDF dialog.
The final sample uses a fresh completed run. Restored-backup provenance behavior is separate from this final PDF layout check.
delivery: Sample HTML and PDF copied to the local release directory. QA page PNGs remain under qa-tmp and are excluded from the source package. No uploads performed.
